title: Mailchimp Model Inclusion and Exclusion Explanation

member_vs_customer.explanation: In Mailchimp's core architecture (Email Marketing & Audience Management), audience contacts are structured as Audience (List) and Member (subscribers). All campaigns, automations, recipient interactions (opens, clicks, bounces), and segmentations link directly to member_id and list_id.
member_vs_customer.customer_usage: The customer table is only populated when a Mailchimp account connects to an E-Commerce store (e.g., Shopify, WooCommerce). The standard dbt package models data around members to remain universal for all Mailchimp users without requiring an e-commerce store integration.

included_models.description: Tables transformed and aggregated by the dbt package

ecommerce_and_store.description: Sales and order tables synced from connected e-commerce storefronts
ecommerce_and_store.exclusion_reason: E-Commerce data is typically analyzed directly from the primary source (e.g., dbt_shopify, ERP/OMS systems) rather than through Mailchimp's intermediary integration.

pre_aggregated_reports.description: Pre-computed summary reporting tables returned by Mailchimp APIs
pre_aggregated_reports.exclusion_reason: The dbt package aggregates metrics (sends, opens, clicks, unique_opens, unique_clicks, unsubscribes) directly from granular event records (campaign_recipient, campaign_recipient_activity), ensuring consistent logic, auditability, and customizable rollup windows instead of relying on static API summaries.

multivariate_ab_testing.description: Detailed combination breakdown tables for multivariate email tests
multivariate_ab_testing.exclusion_reason: The combination_id is already retained and passed through campaign_recipients and campaign_activities. Creating separate intermediate models for each test combination is generally unnecessary for high-level marketing reporting.

interests_and_tags.description: Auxiliary member interest groups and tagging relations
interests_and_tags.exclusion_reason: Audience segmentation is standardized via Segments (segment, segment_member). Member-level tags and custom attributes can be dynamically ingested using the mailchimp__members_pass_through_columns variable.
